title: Subglacial Hum
description: A cavernous, beatless drone that breathes a deep sub bassline beneath a slowly opening pad. Glitchy bitcrushed percussion flickers in and out across a single, very gradual evolution, never settling into a beat, before sinking back into subterranean stillness.
code:
setcpm(72/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(32).range(200,500)).room(0.7).gain(0.42),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(280).gain(0.55).coarse(2),
    s("brown").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(120,400)).gain(0.3).room(0.6)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1 eb2 g1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(24).range(300,900)).room(0.7).gain(0.45),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(320).gain(0.58).crush(8).coarse(2),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.32).crush(6).degradeBy(0.4).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.6"),
    s("brown").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(150,500)).gain(0.3).room(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<[c2,eb2,g2,bb2] [ab1,c2,eb2,g2]>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400,1500)).room(0.6).gain(0.45),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(380).gain(0.6).crush(8).coarse(2).off(0.5, x => x.gain(0.4).lpf(600)),
    s("hh(5,16,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.34).crush(5).sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.speed(1.5)).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.6"),
    s("lt(3,8)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.3).degradeBy(0.5).coarse(3).room(0.55)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c2,eb2,g2,bb2] [ab1,c2,eb2,g2]>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(600,1800)).room(0.8).gain(0.46).delay(".5:.25:.6"),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(360).gain(0.58).crush(8),
    s("brown").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(200,800)).gain(0.32).room(0.7)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<[c2,eb2,g2,bb2] [ab1,c2,eb2,g2] [f1,ab1,c2,eb2] [g1,bb1,d2,f2]>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(500,2000)).room(0.6).gain(0.46).every(4, x => x.rev()),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.6).crush(8).coarse(2).off(0.25, x => x.gain(0.38).lpf(800).crush(4)),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.34).crush(5).sometimesBy(0.35, x => x.speed(2).coarse(4)).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.65"),
    s("lt(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.32).coarse(4).degradeBy(0.4).room(0.6)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180,500)).room(0.85).gain(0.42).delay(".5:.25:.5"),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(260).gain(0.5).coarse(2).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("brown").lpf(saw.slow(32).range(100,300)).gain(0.28).room(0.8)
  )]
)
